issues.description: Path comparison in isIncluded lacks normalization invariant between changedFiles and filename
issues.detail: isIncluded compares slash(cleanUrl(filename)) against this.changedFiles.includes(filename), but VitestGit.findChangedFiles and config.related are not guaranteed to return absolute, slashed, cleaned paths. On Windows or mixed-shape inputs, every file silently mismatches and coverage goes empty. Normalize to one canonical shape at the boundary and document the invariant.

issues.description: Wrong data structure: Array.includes on changedFiles in per-file hot path
issues.detail: changedFiles is a string[] and isIncluded does .includes(filename) for every source file, yielding O(F*C) on cold runs. The textbook fix is a Set<string> built once in onTestRunStart for O(1) lookup. Cache hits help only partially; getUntestedFiles also re-walks.

issues.description: globCache key omits changedFiles state, allowing pre-onTestRunStart calls to poison results
issues.detail: isIncluded caches verdicts keyed only on filename with no dependency on changedFiles. If isIncluded runs before onTestRunStart (config resolution, plugin setup, provider pre-warm), entries cache the unfiltered verdict and survive depending on ordering. Either key on (filename, hasChangedFilter) or audit every call site to enforce the ordering invariant.

issues.description: Three identical onTestRunStart call sites in core.ts invite drift
issues.detail: core.ts manually invokes `await this.coverageProvider?.onTestRunStart?.()` after _testRun.start in three places. Any future run-start path will silently skip coverage filtering. Fold the call into _testRun.start or a single helper so the invariant is enforced from one place.

issues.description: CLI transform for --changed has ambiguous grammar and possibly dead branches
issues.detail: The transform handles 'true'/'yes'/'false'/'no' strings plus boolean inputs the CLI parser may never produce, and shadows rare-but-legal git ref names. Document the precedence (boolean literal first, otherwise treat as ref), compose with any existing sibling helper, and drop or justify the dead boolean branches.

issues.description: cleanUrl added to isIncluded is an unrelated behavior change bundled in without comment or test
issues.detail: Adding cleanUrl to the cache key/match domain silently changes semantics for every caller, collapsing query strings and hashes to bare paths. Probably correct but unrelated to the feature. Split into its own commit with a dedicated test and a one-line literate comment explaining what it defends against.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the feature is the right shape and reasonably scoped, but the path-matching and lifecycle plumbing are fragile. The dominant concerns are path-normalization mismatches between changedFiles and isIncluded inputs, an O(n) array membership test where a Set belongs, and a globCache keyed without regard to filter state. Secondary concerns are three hand-duplicated onTestRunStart call sites in core.ts that will drift, an under-documented CLI boolean transform, and an unrelated cleanUrl behavior change bundled into the feature. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK — tighten normalization, switch to a Set, enforce cache-ordering invariant, and consolidate the lifecycle hook before landing.
